headline: Committee passes water motion 7 to 1, discusses baggage charge proposals

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.summary: One member was excused for the water vote, which followed discussion of a purchase priced at up to $6 million, not counting closing costs. A member proposed $1 per bag and $10 for large items, and another moved to count bags of 50 pounds or more as oversized.
meeting.recap: The price would be up to $6 million, not counting closing costs.[[0:07:32]] No one signed up to testify on the water item.[[0:11:05]] Staff said yearly operating costs are about $879,000 for one system and $671,000 for the other.[[0:18:42]] Staff said current fees bring in more money than it costs to run the systems.[[0:19:23]] The council chair said she wanted to hear from the Board of Water Supply before voting yes.[[0:38:48]] The committee passed the water motion 7 to 1, with one member excused.[[1:04:54]] One testifier asked if Native Hawaiian people could be free of these charges.[[1:11:05]] A finance staffer said Maui's baggage rate is probably the lowest compared with other counties.[[1:17:27]] A member proposed a $1 charge per bag and a $10 charge for large items like surfboards.[[1:19:07]] A member moved to count bags of 50 pounds or more as oversized.[[1:22:32]]
meeting.next: The chair said the water resolution now goes on to the council chair.

moments.q: "Yeah, I'm not gonna support this right now."
